simple.meaning: to cover (specifically with bitumen); figuratively, to expiate or condone , to placate or cancel
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to כָּפַר (H3722) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 103 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: כָּפַר (kâphar) means to cover (specifically with bitumen); figuratively, to expiate or condone , to placate or cancel First listed occurrence: 1Chr 6 34.

definitions.full: H3722. kaphar כִּמֶּר verb Pi`el etc. denominative cover over (figurative), pacify, make propitiation ; — Pi`el Perfect כִּמֶּר Exod 30:10 31 t.; 2 masculine singular suffix כִּמַּרְתָּ֑הוּ Ezek 43:20 ; 3 masculine plural יְכַמְּרוּ 43:26 ; 2 masculine plural כִּמַּרְתֶּם 45:20 ; Imperfect יְכַמֵּר Exod 30:10 10 t.; יְכַמֶּרֿ Lev 7:7 ; Num 5:8 ; suffix יְכַמְּרֶנָּה Prov 16:14 ; 1 singular אֲכַמֵּר 2Sam 21:3 ; אֲכַמְּרָה Gen 32:21 ; Exod 32:30 , etc.; Imperative כַּמֵּר Deut 21:8 4 t.; Infinitive כַּמֵּר Exod 30:15 28 t.; suffixes כַּמְּרִי Ezek 16:63 ; כַּמֶּרְךָ Exod 29:36 ; כַּמְּרָהּ Isa 47:11 ; — 1 cover over, pacify, propitiate ; בַּמִּנְחָה פָנָיו אֲכַמָּרָה Gen 32:21 let me cover his face by the present (so that he does not see the offence, i.e. pacify , him; E; RS OTJC, 2d ed., 381 'wipe clean the face,' blackened by displeasure, as the Arabs say 'whiten the face'); הֹוָה עָלַיִךְ כַּמְּרָהּוְתִמֹּל תוּכְלִי לֹא Isa 47:11 and disaster will fall upon thee, thou wilt not be able to propitiate it (by payment of a כֹּפֶר , see 43:3 ); pacify the wrath of a king Prov 16:14 (e.g. by a gift). 2 cover over, atone for sin , without sacrifice : a. man as subject, אֲכַמֵּר בַּמָּה 2Sam 21:3 , with what shall I cover over (namely, the bloodguiltiness of the house of Saul, says David The answer is by a death penalty of seven sons of the guilty house); חטאתכםבְּעַד Exod 32:30 on behalf of your sins (J E; Moses, by intercession); with על of persons Num 17:11 ; 17:12 (P; by incense), 25:13 (P when Phinehas slays the ringleaders). b. with God as subject, with accusative of person, cover , i.e. treat as covered, view propitiously, Yahweh's land Deut 32:43 (song); לְ person 21:8 (bloodguiltiness flows away in the stream), Ezek 16:63 ; בְּעַד of person 2Chr 30:18 ; with accusative of the sin Psa 65:4 ; 78:38 , probably also Dan 9:24 ׅ || חטאתח֯תם ( ; עַל of sin, Psa 79:9 ; Jer 18:23 ׅ || מחה ( . It is conceived that God in his sovereignty may himself provide an atonement or covering for men and their sins which could not be provided by men. 3 cover over, atone for sin and persons by legal rites , in the codes of H, P, and Ezekiel: absolute ׳וכ הַכֹּהֵן and the priest shall make atonement Lev 16:32 ; a. with accusative of sacred places (by the great sin-offering of the day of atonement), Lev 16:20 , 33 (twice in verse); also Ezek 43:20 , 26 ; 45:20 (by the blood of the sin-offering || טִהַר חִטֵּא, ). b. usually c . עַל (I) of things, e.g. of the altar to which the blood of the sin-offering was applied Exod 29:36-37 , 30:10 ; Lev 8:15 ׅ || קִדַּשׁ ( , 16:18 ; and specifically the horns of the altar Exod 30:10 ; the holy place of the tabernacle Lev 16:16 (by the great sin-offering, because of ׅ מִן ( the uncleannesses of thechildren of Israel and because of their transgressions); for the leprous house by ceremony of purification 14:53 ׅ || טִהַר ( ; for the goat לעזאזל 16:10 (which was presented before Yahweh to consecrate him for the bearing away of the sins of the people). (2) of persons, עלֿ נפשׁתיכם , for your persons, yourselves , e.g. by the payment of atonement-money הַכִּמֻּרִים כֶּסֶף at the census Exod 30:15-16 , by the קרבן of the spoils Num 31:50 ; by the blood upon the altar Lev 17:11 ; in the ritual עָלָיו עֲלֵיהֶם, by ministry of priest through the blood of the sin-offering 4:20 , 31 ; 8:34 ; 10:17 ; 12:7-8 , 14:19 , 31 ; 16:30 , 33 ; 23:28 ; Num 8:12 , 21 ; 15:25 , 28 (twice in verse); 28:22 , 30 ; 29:5 ; 2Chr 29:24 ; Neh 10:34 ; of the trespass-offering Lev 5:16 , 18 ; Leviticus 5:26; 7:7 ; 14:21 ; 19:22 ; Num 5:8 ; the whole burnt-offering Lev 1:4 ; 14:20 ; 16:24 ; by the oil used in purifying a leper 14:18 , 29 ; by the תרומה Ezek 45:15 ; by the priestly ministry in General 1Chr 6:34 ; by the substitution of the Levites for the firstborn Num 8:19 . Underlying all these offerings there is the conception that the persons offering are covered by that which is regarded as sufficient and satisfactory by Yahweh. (The purpose of the covering is stated Lev 16:30 י לִפְנֵי חַטּאֹתֵיכֶם מִכֹּל אֶתְכֶם לְטַהֵר ׳עֲלֵיכֶם תִּטְהָ֑רוּיְכַמֵּר = shall atonement be made for you to cleanse you, from all your sins shall ye be clean before Yahweh , and Num 8:21 לְטַהֲרָם עֲלֵיהֶם וַיְכַמֵּר and ( Aaron ) made atonement for them to cleanse them. ) c. the need of the atonement is expressed by מִן : **others understand מִן as = away from ; compare Di Lev 4:26 , Ri Sühne 50 f . מֵחטאתו because of his sin 4:26 ; 5:6 , 10 ; 16:34 ; מטמאתו 14:19 ; 16:16 ; מזוב 15:15 , 30 ; חָטָא מֵאֲשֶׁר Num 6:11 ; also עַלחַֿטָּאתוֺ עַל on account of his sin Lev 4:35 ; 5:13 ; 19:22 ; עלשֿׁגגתוֺ 5:18 . d. with בְּ instrumental בְּאֵיל Lev 5:16 ; 19:22 ; Num 5:8 ; with a trespass-offering Lev 7:7 ; יְכַמֵּר בַּנֶּפֶשׁ הוּא כִּיהּהַדָּם 17:11 for it is the blood with the living being that covers over (H, see נפשׁ 3 (a); RV by reason of the life after De Di Kn Bähr Kau and most moderns; AV follows ᵑ9 ᵐ5 . ᵑ7 . so Ges Ew § 282 a. Anm. 1 : ' for the soul ' ); with בְּ local בַּקֹּדֶשׁ Lev 6:23 ; 16:17 , 27 . e. with בַּעַד person, on behalf of Lev 9:7 (twice in verse); 16:6 , 11 , 17 , 24 (by Aaron), Ezek 45:17 (by the prince).
